newsitem.title: SWEDEN: GOLF-ROE SETS PACE AFTER THUNDERSTORM.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-ROE SETS PACE AFTER THUNDERSTORM.

text.p: Ryder Cup hopefuls Costantino Rocca and Padraig Harrington emerged from a 3-1/2 hours storm suspension to move within two strokes of the Scandinavian Masters lead on Thursday.
Play was only possible for 30 minutes before a violent thunderstorm sent the players scurrying indoors.
When they returned Italy's Rocca, ninth in Europe's Ryder Cup table as he seeks his third successive appearance, picked up three strokes in seven holes.
Ireland's Harrington, aiming for a cup debut and currently 11th on the list, collected three birdies in eight holes.
This left them two behind early first round leader Mark Roe of Britain who was five-under-par after eight holes.
